response.overview: Beyond the lens capture, is my grandmother's daily life, but I have never touched the fields.I record the daily life of my grandmother, a very ordinary Bai elderly woman. Even at the age of over 70, she still works hard every day, climbing the mountains to pick cypress branches and going down to the fields to plant crops. As I accompany her with my camera, she not only recovers family memories, but also slowly realizes that she was born with Bai values and pride.
response.title: My Dear Granny
